instruction: Candid documentary wide shot of an indoor motion capture studio featuring a red carpet, white walls, and background partitions. On the left, the man in the dark polo shirt and blue shorts (R1) stands facing away and to the right, leaning forward to reach his left hand toward the woman in the white t-shirt and blue jeans (R2). The woman (R2) stands upright on the right side of the frame, facing left and looking directly at him. The entire room is brightly lit by overhead lights, casting soft shadows on the red floor.
elements: R1 leans forward and reaches his left hand toward R2
R2 stands upright and looks at R1 while R1 is the one reaching
R1 is the reaching person rather than R2
R1 uses his left hand for the reaching gesture toward R2
R2 faces and attends to R1 as the target of his reach
